lines.t: In the quiet of the morning, when the world is barely bright
I feel you in the stillness, like a whisper made of light
Every shadow slowly softens
Every worry fades away
You're the calm within my heartbeat
The one who holds my days
And when I tremble and I wonder
When I lose my way again
Your love gathers all my pieces
Teaching broken hearts to mend
And I find you
In the gentle things
In the tears I cry
In the hope you bring
You are near me
In the quiet truth
Every time I fall apart
You pull me through
And I know I'm safe anew
Here where my heart finds you
Every memory you've carried, every tear you've seen me hide
You're the one who sits beside me when I'm drowning deep inside
You turn sorrow into softness, lift the coldness from my bones
You remind me I am cherished, I am never walking alone
So when the winds beat and they're shaking
And my fear begins to rise
You breathe peace into the chaos
Till the storm inside me dies
And I find you in the gentle things
In the tears I cry, in the hope you bring, you are near me
In the quiet truth, every time I fall apart, you pull me through
And I know I'm safe anew, here where my heart finds you
You're the warmth inside the winter, you're the fire in the rain
You're the hand that lifts my spirit when I can't lift it again
You're the song beneath my breathing, you're the light behind my eyes
You're the love that never leaves me, the one who hears my sighs
And I find you in the gentle things
In the tears I cry, in the hope you bring
You are near me, in the quiet truth
Every time I fall apart, you pull me through
Hearing all you say and do
My heart finds home in you
Thank you.
